{{Quote|It looks like a giant skipper squid exploded on the battlefield, sir...I can't take two steps without putting my boot into blue slime.|RSF Lieutenant [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], reporting from the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] battlefield near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''cesta''' was a wooden military staff produced by the [[Otoh Gunga Defense League/Legends|Otoh Gunga Defense League]] and employed by the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
[[File:Militiagung-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|A kaadu-riding Militiagung wielding a cesta and booma]]
The hand-carved cesta was used as a staff-like melee weapon or a blocking device, but also doubled as a means of launching [[Booma/Legends|boomas]] at targets. Essentially a larger version of the [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatl]], the cesta was tipped with a cradle large enough to accommodate a single energy ball. When used to hurl energy balls, the cesta was slightly more accurate than an atlatl.<ref name="SECR" /> A proficient Gungan warrior used his cesta to fling a booma around one hundred meters, though such throws were not always accurate due to the primitive nature of the weapon. Because of their culture, Gungans had a natural proficiency when wielding the cesta, whereas others who were not trained with it would have trouble wielding it.<ref name="SECR" /> The cesta's cradle was often decorated with carvings of symbols and icons of personal significance to individual warriors. Survivors of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]] memorialized their fallen comrades by carving their names into the handles of their cestas.

==Users==
Cestas were commonly used by the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|militiagungs]] of the Gungan Grand Army. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] set up a training ground near [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] known as the [[Scrumma Jawbone]], which served as a "shooting range" for cesta, [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatl]] and [[arbalest]] users.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

Cestas were rarely found outside Gungun culture.<ref name="SECR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Wars_RPG_Cesta.jpg|thumb|right|An illustration of a cesta]]
[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']] labels two different weapons as the "cesta", one of which is a simple throwing spear, the other is a cup-tipped weapon which other sources have correctly identified as the atlatl. The [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] entry on [[StarWars.com]] seems to confirm this with a picture of Jar Jar Binks wielding a throwing spear.
